items.question: Is a privacy link present in supplied evidence?
evidence_needed: Screenshot or extracted page text showing a labelled privacy link.
assessment_criteria: Evidence shows a labelled privacy link.
Link presence does not establish notice completeness.

items.question: Has privacy notice content been captured?
evidence_needed: Captured text or screenshot of the privacy notice.
assessment_criteria: Content is present in supplied evidence.
Missing content is Not verified, not Fail.

items.question: Is a cookie notice or settings entry present?
evidence_needed: Screenshot or extracted text showing the notice or settings entry.
assessment_criteria: Evidence shows a cookie notice or settings entry.
HTML controls alone do not prove visual prominence.

items.question: Has the initial consent interface been captured?
evidence_needed: Initial-page screenshot or manual evidence description.
assessment_criteria: Screenshots do not establish tracking behaviour.

items.question: Has newsletter form information been captured?
evidence_needed: Screenshot or text showing labels and privacy information near the form.

items.question: Has tracking behaviour been verified with appropriate evidence?
evidence_needed: Authorized technical evidence with method and limitations.
assessment_criteria: Script references do not prove execution.
Screenshot evidence cannot establish tracking behaviour.

items.question: Are internal controls supported by authorized evidence?
evidence_needed: Authorized internal evidence or a specific reason it is unavailable.
assessment_criteria: Only authorized internal evidence may support this item.
Public pages do not establish internal controls.
